# API reference

Generated from the source of `github.com/otfabric/go-canopen` with `docsync api`; the doc comments are the documentation. The guides around it explain how the pieces fit.

| Package | Synopsis |
|---|---|
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen](go-canopen.md) | Package canopen is the shared core of go-canopen, a CANopen (CiA 301) implementation on top of go-canbus: node identifiers, COB-IDs and the predefined connection set, the CANopen data types and their encoding, SDO abort codes and the NMT states and commands. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/cdcf](cdcf.md) | Package cdcf is the concise DCF of CiA 302-3: the binary form of a node configuration that a CANopen manager keeps in its object 0x1F22 (one DOMAIN sub-object per node) and writes to the node at boot-up. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/cia402](cia402.md) | Package cia402 implements the CiA 402 drive profile (IEC 61800-7-201): the power drive state machine, the modes of operation and the common 0x6xxx objects, a device-side drive model and a master-side controller. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/codegen](codegen.md) | Package codegen generates typed Go code from an EDS or DCF (eds.File): index and sub-index constants for every object, a NewDictionary function that builds the object dictionary without parsing anything at run time, a typed local accessor over an od.Dictionary and a typed remote accessor over an SDO client. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/dissect](dissect.md) | Package dissect interprets CAN frames as CANopen messages by the predefined connection set (CiA 301 7.3.5, canopen.Classify): NMT, SYNC, TIME, EMCY, PDOs, SDO requests and responses, NMT error control (heartbeat, boot-up, node guarding) and LSS (CiA 305). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/eds](eds.md) | Package eds reads, validates and writes CANopen electronic data sheets (EDS) and device configuration files (DCF) as CiA 306-1 specifies them, and converts them to and from an od.Dictionary. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/emcy](emcy.md) | Package emcy implements the CANopen emergency object (CiA 301 7.2.7). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/lss](lss.md) | Package lss implements the CANopen layer setting services (CiA 305): an LSS Master that inquires and configures the node-ID and the bit timing of devices identified by their 128-bit LSS address (the identity object 0x1018), and finds unconfigured devices with Fastscan; and an LSS Slave, the LSS state machine of a device. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/master](master.md) | Package master is a CANopen network manager (an NMT master with the services a CiA 302 manager uses): NMT commands, heartbeat supervision, emergency reception, SDO clients for every node, network scan, node configuration (from entries or a DCF), a boot procedure, remote PDOs, SYNC and TIME production, CiA 402 drive control, an LSS master, MPDO configuration, CANopen FD (USDO) and the CiA 302 manager. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/mpdo](mpdo.md) | Package mpdo implements CANopen multiplexed PDOs (MPDOs, CiA 301 7.2.2.4 and the object scanner and dispatcher lists 0x1FA0..0x1FFF): PDOs that carry one value of up to 4 bytes together with the object it belongs to, so that one COB-ID can transport many objects. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/nmt](nmt.md) | Package nmt implements CANopen network management (CiA 301 7.2.8 and 7.3.2): NMT module control and NMT error control. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/node](node.md) | Package node is a complete CANopen device (CiA 301) built from an object dictionary: New chooses the communication services from the objects the dictionary has, Node.Start starts them and sends the boot-up message, and the NMT state machine enables and disables them. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/od](od.md) | Package od is the CANopen object dictionary (CiA 301 7.4): objects addressed by a 16-bit index and an 8-bit sub-index, with data types, access rights, PDO mappability, default values and limits. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/pdo](pdo.md) | Package pdo implements CANopen process data objects (CiA 301 7.2.2, 7.5.2.35..38): mapping entries and the bit-exact packing of mapped values, the transmit and receive PDOs of a device, and a master's tools to configure a node's PDOs over SDO and to decode and produce PDOs. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/program](program.md) | Package program is the program download of CiA 302-3 on the device side: the objects through which a CANopen manager replaces the application software of a device over SDO. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/sdo](sdo.md) | Package sdo implements the CANopen service data object (CiA 301 7.2.4): a Client that reads (uploads) and writes (downloads) sub-objects of a remote object dictionary, and a Server that serves an od.Dictionary. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/store](store.md) | Package store keeps the parameters of a CANopen device across restarts: the persistence behind the store parameters (0x1010) and restore default parameters (0x1011) objects of CiA 301. |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/sync](sync.md) | Package syncobj implements the CANopen SYNC object (CiA 301 7.2.5). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/timestamp](timestamp.md) | Package timestamp implements the CANopen TIME object (CiA 301 7.2.6) and the TIME_OF_DAY and TIME_DIFFERENCE data types (CiA 301 7.1.6.5). |
| [github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/usdo](usdo.md) | Package usdo implements the universal service data object (USDO) of CANopen FD (CiA 1301), which replaces the SDO: a Client reads and writes the object dictionaries of [Server]s over CAN FD frames, to one node, to a group or to all nodes, with several transfers at once. |
